high_level_description: The image shows a person taking a mirror selfie in what appears to be a bathroom or dressing room. The individual is wearing a black blazer over a black top with a plunging neckline. They have on a pair of wide-leg pants with a floral pattern featuring large, light-colored flowers on a dark background. The person is accessorized with multiple gold necklaces, bracelets, and rings, and they are holding a small, light-colored handbag with a chain strap. The setting includes a white door with a doorknob and a tiled floor with a geometric pattern.
